## Notes

Doug Dyment, 1968, FOCAL on PDP-8; each round is a year: adviser report, then grain for land at 17-26 bushels per acre, seed, and food; random harvest, rats, immigration, plague halving population; game ends if 45% starve in a round; 10 rounds.
